name: Shattered Shield
desc: HYDRA splinter cells hit the Tower district. Push them back.

name: Case the Safehouse
desc: Walk Lang's block and map the patrols.
point_lines: "Corner's covered. Two cameras, both pointed at the ATM and not the door."
"Patrol comes past here every eleven minutes. Same two, same route, same cigarette break."
"Back of the building. One fire door, no handle on the outside, and somebody has been propping it open with a brick."

name: Spoof the Ankle Monitor
desc: Plant 3 relays to blind Lang's monitor.
point_lines: "Relay one, on the transformer box. It'll tell the monitor Lang has been sitting on his couch since Tuesday."
"Two of three. This one goes on the lamppost, and it thinks it's a parking sensor. It is not a parking sensor."
"Three. Lang's ankle now reports from an apartment he isn't in, and it will keep reporting until somebody physically climbs up there."

name: Break Out Scott Lang
desc: HYDRA got to Lang first. Get him out - the Pym suit comes with him.

name: Siege of the Tower
desc: A HYDRA Siege Captain leads an assault on the Tower itself.

name: Cell Hunt
desc: Chase the surviving splinter cell through the docks.

name: Crossbones
desc: The man behind the splinter cells. He does not intend to be arrested.
